verdict.rationale: The product's own read endpoint returns each transcription job's results in open formats: JSON by default, or SRT, VTT, and WebVTT. Nothing documents bulk export of all account data or a way to leave, such as account deletion. The 12-hour privacy deletion is a different, related control and earns no credit. Missing for 10: bulk or account-wide export of all jobs and transcripts, export of account metadata, a documented account-closure or offboarding process, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: This endpoint allows you to check the status of an existing transcription job and retrieve its results if available.
Valid options are srt, vtt, or webvtt. If not provided, the output will be in JSON format.
